description: Save an API/workflow endpoint so a behavioral gate can target it. This is the ONLY way to gate an authenticated endpoint: the credential is stored envelope-encrypted here and is never returned, whereas an inline `http` descriptor is rejected (422) if it carries one. Using a saved endpoint also lets EdgeGate refuse a run whose endpoint differs from the baseline's. Requires workspace admin access.

endpoint_url.description: https URL EdgeGate will call. Internal targets (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, the cloud metadata IP) are refused with 422.

request_template.description: Webhook body shape with {{prompt}} and {{case_id}} placeholders, e.g. {"chatInput": "{{prompt}}", "case_id": "{{case_id}}"}. Match your workflow's own input field — n8n often nests it under body.

response_text_path.description: Dotted path to the reply text in the response, e.g. 'reply' or 'json.output'. Verify it with edgegate_probe_workflow_endpoint before capturing a baseline.

response_tools_path.description: Dotted path to tool calls in the response, if the workflow emits them.

secret.description: Bearer credential for the endpoint. Stored envelope-encrypted and never returned by any read path — only has_secret and secret_last4 are visible afterwards. This is the only supported way to gate an authenticated endpoint.

transport.description: 'webhook' for n8n/Zapier/Make (posts request_template, reads response_text_path); 'openai_chat' for an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions API. Defaults to openai_chat.

name: edgegate_create_workflow_endpoint
